purpose: The circle before yours page of the Udaipur Grimoire (Logout-Spells-Udaipur-2-4-Oct-2026-Grimoire-v2.pdf).
photoMethod: Original founder-supplied photographs already prepared for the Content Spell (img/content-memories, attachments 1-8 of that request). The previous Udaipur spell strip uses the four Udaipur photographs (attachments 5-8); the previous Logout Spells strip uses the four Bir photographs (attachments 1-4). Full image proportions are retained; no faces, scenes or details are regenerated.
reviewMethod: Excerpts are contiguous passages from the visible message transcriptions recorded in img/content-memories/sources.json (attachments 9-14 of the Content Spell request, messages from the previous Udaipur spell group), with punctuation and initial capitalization normalized only. Passages that name a host or a workshop are not used. Unnamed messages are attributed only to the group.
wordsSubtitle: EXCERPTS FROM THE PREVIOUS UDAIPUR SPELL GROUP
